# Rogue Code — Web Development & AI Automation Agency
> Rogue Code builds custom websites, AI agents, mobile apps, and UI/UX design for businesses worldwide. From concept to deployment, we ship production-grade code that you own, forever. Specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, LangChain, and modern full-stack development.

## Services
- Custom Web Development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- AI Agents & Automation (LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Python)
- Mobile App Development (React Native, Firebase)
- UI/UX Design
- API Development & Integration
- AI Chatbots & Assistants

## Pricing
- Basic: ₹7,000/mo — 5-page responsive website, mobile-first design, basic SEO
- Business: ₹14,000/mo — Custom web app or AI automation, CMS, 30-day support
- Enterprise: ₹25,000/mo — Full-stack product, AI integration, dedicated team
- Custom Animated: ₹3,00,000 — Custom 3D/WebGL experiences, cinematic animations
